; Shared reading-enhancements source for 3.27 and 3.28.
; The build step derives the minimum 3.27 boundary variant for MainView.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolSettingsRoot: parent

            function rmtoolReadingSelectedPage() {
                return ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolSettingsRoot)
                    ? rmtoolSettingsRoot._selectedPage
                    : rmtoolSettingsRoot._selectedIndex
            }

            function rmtoolSelectReadingPage(page) {
                if ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolSettingsRoot) {
                    rmtoolSettingsRoot._selectedPage = page
                } else {
                    rmtoolSettingsRoot._selectedIndex = page
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar > ColumnLayout#settingsColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: rmtoolReadingEnhancementsSidebarItem
                objectName: "rmtoolReadingEnhancementsSidebarItem"
                type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                text: showLabels ? "阅读增强" : ""
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/ebook"
                highlighted: settingsSidebar.rmtoolReadingSelectedPage() === 1001
                focusPolicy: Qt.StrongFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onTriggered: {
                    settingsSidebar.rmtoolSelectReadingPage(1001)
                    sidebarTimer.running = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#payloadLoader
        REBUILD sourceComponent
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/ 
            INSERT STREAM /if (settingsSidebar.rmtoolReadingSelectedPage() === 1001) return rmtoolReadingEnhancements;/
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        LOCATE BEFORE Component#general
        INSERT {
            Component {
                id: rmtoolReadingEnhancements

                Item {
                    id: rmtoolReadingPage
                    objectName: "rmtoolReadingEnhancementsPage"

                    readonly property string group: "RmtoolReadingEnhancements"
                    readonly property int privatePage: 1001
                    readonly property var intervalChoices: [5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30]
                    property bool masterEnabled: true
                    property bool tapPageTurnEnabled: false
                    property bool fastMonoEnabled: false
                    property bool cleanupEnabled: false
                    property bool cleanupByChapter: false
                    property int cleanupInterval: 10

                    function readBool(key, fallback) {
                        const value = Settings.rawValue(group, key)
                        return value === undefined || value === null ? fallback : !!value
                    }

                    function normalizedInterval(value) {
                        let number = Number(value)
                        if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
                            return 10
                        }
                        number = Math.round(number / 5) * 5
                        return Math.max(5, Math.min(30, number))
                    }

                    function readSettings() {
                        masterEnabled = readBool("masterEnabled", true)
                        tapPageTurnEnabled = readBool("tapPageTurnEnabled", false)
                        fastMonoEnabled = readBool("fastMonoEnabled", false)
                        cleanupEnabled = readBool("cleanupEnabled", false)
                        cleanupByChapter = readBool("cleanupByChapter", false)
                        cleanupInterval = normalizedInterval(Settings.rawValue(group, "cleanupInterval"))
                    }

                    function writeBool(key, value) {
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, key, !!value)
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function writeInterval(value) {
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, "cleanupInterval", normalizedInterval(value))
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function stepInterval(delta) {
                        const index = intervalChoices.indexOf(cleanupInterval)
                        const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(intervalChoices.length - 1, index + delta))
                        writeInterval(intervalChoices[next])
                    }

                    Component.onCompleted: readSettings()

                    ScrollArea {
                        id: rmtoolReadingScroll
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: rmtoolReadingWrapper.childrenRect.height
                            + ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                        enableScrollbar: true
                        permanentScrollbar: true
                        scrollbarTopMargin: rmtoolReadingHeader.y

                        Item {
                            id: rmtoolReadingWrapper
                            implicitWidth: rmtoolReadingScroll.width

                            ArkControls.PlaceholderBar {
                                id: rmtoolReadingPlaceholder
                                width: parent.width
                            }

                            ArkControls.Title {
                                id: rmtoolReadingHeader
                                type: ArkControls.Title.Large
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolReadingPlaceholder.bottom
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                text: "阅读增强"
                            }

                            ColumnLayout {
                                id: rmtoolReadingColumn
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolReadingHeader.bottom
                                    topMargin: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                spacing: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "启用阅读增强"
                                    description: "关闭后暂时停用所有阅读增强功能，已保存的设置会保留。"
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolReadingPage.writeBool(
                                            "masterEnabled", !rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "点击翻页"
                                    description: "在 PDF 和 EPUB 阅读页点击屏幕区域翻页。笔记本保持原生手势。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolReadingPage.tapPageTurnEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolReadingPage.writeBool(
                                            "tapPageTurnEnabled", !rmtoolReadingPage.tapPageTurnEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "快速黑白阅读模式"
                                    description: "作为全局授权；开启后可在每本 PDF/EPUB 的阅读菜单中独立开关。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolReadingPage.fastMonoEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolReadingPage.writeBool(
                                            "fastMonoEnabled", !rmtoolReadingPage.fastMonoEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "翻页清残影"
                                    description: "翻页后使用系统整屏刷新清理残影，彩色和黑白模式均可用。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolReadingPage.writeBool(
                                            "cleanupEnabled", !rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "按章节清残影"
                                    description: "有目录时跨越目录边界清理；没有目录时使用固定页数。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupEnabled
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                            && rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupEnabled
                                        checked: rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupByChapter
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolReadingPage.writeBool(
                                            "cleanupByChapter", !rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupByChapter)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    id: rmtoolIntervalPanel
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "固定页数间隔"
                                    description: "每隔 %1 页清理一次残影。"
                                        .arg(rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupInterval)
                                    enabled: rmtoolReadingPage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupEnabled
                                        && !rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupByChapter
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    showAttachment: true
                                    attachment: RowLayout {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "-"
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolIntervalPanel.enabled
                                                && rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupInterval > 5
                                            onClicked: rmtoolReadingPage.stepInterval(-1)
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupInterval.toString()
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolIntervalPanel.enabled
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "+"
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolIntervalPanel.enabled
                                                && rmtoolReadingPage.cleanupInterval < 30
                                            onClicked: rmtoolReadingPage.stepInterval(1)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolTapPageTurnToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolTapPageTurnToggle"
                label: "点击翻页"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolReadingAvailable ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolMasterEnabled ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolGlobalTapPageTurnEnabled ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolTapPageTurnEnabled ?? false
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetTapPageTurnEnabled(!view.rmtoolDocumentTapPageTurnEnabled)
                    view.showNotification({
                        message: view.rmtoolDocumentTapPageTurnEnabled
                            ? "点击翻页已开启" : "点击翻页已关闭"
                    })
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolFastMonoToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolFastMonoToggle"
                label: "快速黑白"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolMasterEnabled ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolGlobalFastMonoEnabled ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled ?? false
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetFastMonoEnabled(!view.rmtoolDocumentFastMonoEnabled)
                    view.showNotification({
                        message: view.rmtoolDocumentFastMonoEnabled
                            ? "快速黑白已开启" : "快速黑白已关闭"
                    })
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolCleanupToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolCleanupToggle"
                label: "强制刷新"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolReadingAvailable ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolMasterEnabled ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolGlobalCleanupEnabled ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupEnabled ?? false
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetCleanupEnabled(!view.rmtoolDocumentCleanupEnabled)
                    view.showNotification({
                        message: view.rmtoolDocumentCleanupEnabled
                            ? "强制刷新已开启" : "强制刷新已关闭"
                    })
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: rmtoolCleanupOptions

                ColumnLayout {
                    spacing: 0

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 5 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 5
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(5)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 10 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 10
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(10)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 15 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 15
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(15)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 20 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 20
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(20)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 25 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 25
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(25)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "每 30 次翻页"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter === false
                            && root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupInterval === 30
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(false)
                            view.rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(30)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "按章节"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter ?? false
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(true)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                id: rmtoolCleanupSelector
                objectName: "rmtoolCleanupSelector"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolReadingAvailable ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolMasterEnabled ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolGlobalCleanupEnabled ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolCleanupEnabled ?? false)
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                label: "刷新方式"
                description: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                    if (view?.rmtoolCleanupByChapter) {
                        return "按章节"
                    }
                    return "每 " + (view?.rmtoolCleanupInterval ?? 10) + " 次翻页"
                }
                onClicked: stackView.push(rmtoolCleanupOptions)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
    TRAVERSE TouchArea#touchArea
        LOCATE BEFORE TouchAreaClickFilter#touchClick
        INSERT {
            function rmtoolTapPageDirection(pos) {
                if (view.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolTapPageTurnEnabled !== true
                    || touchArea.gesturesBlocked
                    || !view.clickGestureEnabled
                    || view.zoomedIn
                    || view.zoomedOut
                    || view.notePage
                    || view.textMode
                    || view.itemSelectionMode
                    || view.textSelectionMode
                    || !view.document
                    || (view.document.fileType !== Document.Pdf
                        && view.document.fileType !== Document.Ebook)) {
                    return 0
                }

                const normalizedX = pos.x / touchArea.width
                const normalizedY = pos.y / touchArea.height

                if (normalizedX < 0.40
                    && normalizedY >= 0.38
                    && normalizedY < 0.65) {
                    return -1
                }

                if ((normalizedX >= 0.75 && normalizedY < 0.65)
                    || normalizedY >= 0.65) {
                    return 1
                }

                return 0
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE TouchAreaClickFilter#touchClick
            REBUILD onClick
                LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
                INSERT {
                    const rmtoolDirection = touchArea.rmtoolTapPageDirection(pos)
                    if (!linkPressed && rmtoolDirection < 0) {
                        console.warn("RMTOOL-READING: previous")
                        reset()
                        view.moveBackward()
                        return
                    }
                    if (!linkPressed && rmtoolDirection > 0) {
                        console.warn("RMTOOL-READING: next")
                        reset()
                        view.moveForward()
                        return
                    }
                }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool rmtoolMasterEnabled: true
            property bool rmtoolGlobalTapPageTurnEnabled: false
            property bool rmtoolGlobalFastMonoEnabled: false
            property bool rmtoolGlobalCleanupEnabled: false
            property bool rmtoolGlobalCleanupByChapter: false
            property int rmtoolGlobalCleanupInterval: 10
            property bool rmtoolDocumentTapPageTurnEnabled: true
            property bool rmtoolDocumentFastMonoEnabled: true
            property bool rmtoolDocumentCleanupEnabled: true
            property bool rmtoolDocumentCleanupByChapter: true
            property int rmtoolDocumentCleanupInterval: 10
            property bool rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled: false
            property bool rmtoolCleanupEnabled: false
            property bool rmtoolCleanupByChapter: false
            property int rmtoolCleanupInterval: 10
            property int rmtoolCleanupCount: 0
            property int rmtoolCleanupLastPage: -1
            property int rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary: -1
            property string rmtoolCleanupLastDocumentId: ""
            readonly property bool rmtoolReadingAvailable: !!document
                && !notePage
                && (document.fileType === Document.Pdf
                    || document.fileType === Document.Ebook)
            readonly property bool rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable: rmtoolReadingAvailable
                && EPFramebuffer.hasCapability(EPFramebuffer.Capability.Color)

            readonly property string rmtoolReadingDocumentId: document && document.id !== undefined
                && document.id !== null ? document.id.toString() : ""
            readonly property bool rmtoolTapPageTurnEnabled: rmtoolMasterEnabled
                && rmtoolGlobalTapPageTurnEnabled && rmtoolDocumentTapPageTurnEnabled
                && rmtoolReadingAvailable
            readonly property bool rmtoolCleanupEffective: rmtoolMasterEnabled
                && rmtoolGlobalCleanupEnabled && rmtoolDocumentCleanupEnabled
                && rmtoolReadingAvailable

            Component.onCompleted: rmtoolReadReadingSettings()
            onRmtoolReadingDocumentIdChanged: rmtoolReadReadingSettings()

            function rmtoolDocumentKey(key) {
                if (!rmtoolReadingDocumentId) {
                    return ""
                }
                return "documents/" + rmtoolReadingDocumentId + "/" + key
            }

            function readBool(key, fallback) {
                const value = Settings.rawValue("RmtoolReadingEnhancements", key)
                return value === undefined || value === null ? fallback : !!value
            }

            function rmtoolNormalizedInterval(value) {
                let number = Number(value)
                if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
                    return 10
                }
                number = Math.round(number / 5) * 5
                return Math.max(5, Math.min(30, number))
            }

            function rmtoolReadScopedBool(key, fallback) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return fallback
                }
                return readBool(scopedKey, fallback)
            }

            function rmtoolReadScopedInterval(key, fallback) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return rmtoolNormalizedInterval(fallback)
                }
                const raw = Settings.rawValue("RmtoolReadingEnhancements", scopedKey)
                return raw === undefined || raw === null
                    ? rmtoolNormalizedInterval(fallback) : rmtoolNormalizedInterval(raw)
            }

            function rmtoolReadReadingSettings() {
                const previousDocumentId = rmtoolCleanupLastDocumentId
                const masterEnabled = readBool("masterEnabled", true)
                const globalTap = readBool("tapPageTurnEnabled", false)
                const globalFastMono = readBool("fastMonoEnabled", false)
                const globalCleanup = readBool("cleanupEnabled", false)
                const globalByChapter = readBool("cleanupByChapter", false)
                const globalInterval = rmtoolNormalizedInterval(
                    Settings.rawValue("RmtoolReadingEnhancements", "cleanupInterval"))
                const documentTap = rmtoolReadScopedBool("tapPageTurnEnabled", true)
                const documentFastMono = rmtoolReadScopedBool("fastMonoEnabled", true)
                const documentCleanup = rmtoolReadScopedBool("cleanupEnabled", true)
                const documentByChapter = rmtoolReadScopedBool(
                    "cleanupByChapter", globalByChapter)
                const documentInterval = rmtoolReadScopedInterval(
                    "cleanupInterval", globalInterval)
                const effectiveCleanup = masterEnabled && globalCleanup && documentCleanup
                const effectiveByChapter = effectiveCleanup && documentByChapter
                const resetCleanup = previousDocumentId !== rmtoolReadingDocumentId
                    || effectiveCleanup !== rmtoolCleanupEnabled
                    || effectiveByChapter !== rmtoolCleanupByChapter
                    || documentInterval !== rmtoolCleanupInterval

                rmtoolMasterEnabled = masterEnabled
                rmtoolGlobalTapPageTurnEnabled = globalTap
                rmtoolGlobalFastMonoEnabled = globalFastMono
                rmtoolGlobalCleanupEnabled = globalCleanup
                rmtoolGlobalCleanupByChapter = globalByChapter
                rmtoolGlobalCleanupInterval = globalInterval
                rmtoolDocumentTapPageTurnEnabled = documentTap
                rmtoolDocumentFastMonoEnabled = documentFastMono
                rmtoolDocumentCleanupEnabled = documentCleanup
                rmtoolDocumentCleanupByChapter = documentByChapter
                rmtoolDocumentCleanupInterval = documentInterval
                rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled = masterEnabled && globalFastMono && documentFastMono
                rmtoolCleanupEnabled = effectiveCleanup
                rmtoolCleanupByChapter = effectiveByChapter
                rmtoolCleanupInterval = documentInterval
                rmtoolCleanupLastDocumentId = rmtoolReadingDocumentId
                if (resetCleanup) {
                    rmtoolResetReadingCleanup()
                    rmtoolCleanupLastPage = currentPage
                    rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary = rmtoolTocBoundaryForPage(currentPage)
                }
            }

            function rmtoolWriteDocumentBool(key, value) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return
                }
                Settings.setRawValue("RmtoolReadingEnhancements", scopedKey, !!value)
                rmtoolReadReadingSettings()
            }

            function rmtoolWriteDocumentInterval(value) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolDocumentKey("cleanupInterval")
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return
                }
                Settings.setRawValue("RmtoolReadingEnhancements", scopedKey,
                    rmtoolNormalizedInterval(value))
                rmtoolReadReadingSettings()
            }

            function rmtoolSetTapPageTurnEnabled(value) {
                rmtoolWriteDocumentBool("tapPageTurnEnabled", value)
            }

            function rmtoolSetFastMonoEnabled(value) {
                rmtoolWriteDocumentBool("fastMonoEnabled", value)
            }

            function rmtoolSetCleanupEnabled(value) {
                rmtoolWriteDocumentBool("cleanupEnabled", value)
            }

            function rmtoolSetCleanupByChapter(value) {
                rmtoolWriteDocumentBool("cleanupByChapter", value)
            }

            function rmtoolSetCleanupInterval(value) {
                rmtoolWriteDocumentInterval(value)
            }

            function rmtoolResetReadingCleanup() {
                rmtoolCleanupCount = 0
                rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary = -1
                rmtoolCleanupTimer.stop()
            }

            function rmtoolTocBoundaryForPage(page) {
                if (!rmtoolCleanupByChapter || !tocModel || tocModel.length === 0) {
                    return -1
                }
                let boundary = -1
                for (let index = 0; index < tocModel.length; index++) {
                    const item = tocModel[index]
                    const itemPage = Number(item.page ?? item.pageNumber ?? -1)
                    if (Number.isFinite(itemPage) && itemPage >= 0 && itemPage <= page) {
                        boundary = itemPage
                    }
                }
                return boundary
            }

            function rmtoolHasUsableToc() {
                if (!rmtoolCleanupByChapter || !tocModel || tocModel.length === 0) {
                    return false
                }
                for (let index = 0; index < tocModel.length; index++) {
                    const item = tocModel[index]
                    const itemPage = Number(item.page ?? item.pageNumber ?? -1)
                    if (Number.isFinite(itemPage) && itemPage >= 0) {
                        return true
                    }
                }
                return false
            }

            function rmtoolScheduleReadingCleanup() {
                rmtoolCleanupTimer.restart()
            }

            Timer {
                id: rmtoolCleanupTimer
                interval: 500
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.rmtoolReadingAvailable && root.rmtoolCleanupEffective) {
                        root.ghostBuster.forceClearNow("rmtool reading enhancements cleanup")
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root

                function onVisibleChanged() {
                    if (root.visible) {
                        root.rmtoolReadReadingSettings()
                    }
                }

                function onTocModelChanged() {
                    root.rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary = root.rmtoolTocBoundaryForPage(
                        root.currentPage)
                }

                function onCurrentPageChanged() {
                    const page = root.currentPage
                    const documentId = root.rmtoolReadingDocumentId
                    if (documentId !== root.rmtoolCleanupLastDocumentId) {
                        root.rmtoolCleanupLastDocumentId = documentId
                        root.rmtoolResetReadingCleanup()
                        root.rmtoolCleanupLastPage = page
                        root.rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary = root.rmtoolTocBoundaryForPage(page)
                        return
                    }
                    if (page < 0 || root.rmtoolCleanupLastPage < 0
                        || page === root.rmtoolCleanupLastPage) {
                        root.rmtoolCleanupLastPage = page
                        return
                    }

                    root.rmtoolCleanupLastPage = page
                    if (!root.rmtoolReadingAvailable || !root.rmtoolCleanupEnabled) {
                        return
                    }

                    const boundary = root.rmtoolTocBoundaryForPage(page)
                    if (root.rmtoolCleanupByChapter && boundary >= 0
                        && boundary !== root.rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary) {
                        root.rmtoolCleanupLastBoundary = boundary
                        root.rmtoolCleanupCount = 0
                        root.rmtoolScheduleReadingCleanup()
                        return
                    }
                    if (root.rmtoolCleanupByChapter && root.rmtoolHasUsableToc()) {
                        return
                    }

                    root.rmtoolCleanupCount += 1
                    if (root.rmtoolCleanupCount >= root.rmtoolCleanupInterval) {
                        root.rmtoolCleanupCount = 0
                        root.rmtoolScheduleReadingCleanup()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > DeviceSceneView#sceneView
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolDocumentView: root
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolDocumentView: root
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?[!mode][!visible]
        REPLACE visible WITH {
            visible: (rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable && rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled)
                || sceneView.globalScreenMode != undefined
        }
        REPLACE mode WITH {
            mode: rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable && rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled
                ? Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Mono
                : (visible ? sceneView.globalScreenMode : Epaper.ScreenModeItem.UI)
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
